display_name: PROMIS: Sleep disturbance 8b sum of 8 items (range: 8-40)
description:
Calculated - Raw summary score for the PROMIS Sleep Disturbance 8b instrument. Each item ranges from 1 to 5. The raw score is the sum of 8 items. [Yu L et al, 2012 (PMID: 22250775)](https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/pmc/articles/PMC3261577/)

[Search for all PROMIS SRI variables within this dataset](https://sleepdata.org/datasets/mesa/variables?search=promissd)
